methodology.framework: ISO 14040/14044 Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) compliant methodology
methodology.plastic_avoidance_formula: Plastic Avoided (g) = Plastic weight per conventional item (g) × Number of items replaced
methodology.co2e_avoidance_formula: Net CO₂e Avoided (kg) = (Conventional product lifecycle emissions − Sustainable alternative lifecycle emissions) × Number of equivalent replacements

sustainable_product.name: Eco Saathi Biodegradable Bamboo Toothbrush
sustainable_product.material: Wild-harvested sustainably grown Moso bamboo handle + charcoal-infused soft bristles

comparisons.lifetime_assumptions: Dentists recommend replacing manual toothbrushes every 3 months (4 per year). Replacing 4 plastic toothbrushes per year eliminates 80g of plastic and 244g of CO₂e annually.
comparisons.data_source: Nature - British Dental Journal (BDJ) 2020 & Trinity College Dublin LCA Study
comparisons.citation: Lyne, A., et al. (2020). Combining life cycle assessment and circularity for a toothbrush. British Dental Journal, 229(10), 646–652. doi:10.1038/s41415-020-2270-3

sustainable_product.name: Eco Saathi Medicinal Neem Wood Detangler Comb
sustainable_product.material: Seasoned pruned medicinal Azadirachta indica (Neem) timber

comparisons.lifetime_assumptions: A single durable, seasoned neem wood comb lasts 3+ years with simple natural oil conditioning, directly replacing an average of 3 brittle plastic combs that snap or shed microplastics into wastewater.
comparisons.data_source: PlasticsEurope Eco-profile (Polypropylene) & Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE)
comparisons.citation: PlasticsEurope (2021). Eco-profiles and Environmental Product Declarations of the European Plastics Industry - Polypropylene (PP); ICFRE Agroforestry Wood Carbon Assessment.

sustainable_product.name: Eco Saathi Heavy-Duty Reusable Jute Market Bag
sustainable_product.material: Natural golden jute fiber woven by coastal Odisha cooperatives

comparisons.lifetime_assumptions: A durable jute market tote has a lifespan of ~300 grocery shopping trips over 2 years. Its embodied manufacturing footprint (0.42 kg CO₂e) amortized over 300 uses equals only 0.0014 kg CO₂e per trip.
comparisons.data_source: UK Environment Agency Report SC030292 & US EPA WARM v15 Database
comparisons.citation: UK Environment Agency (2011). Life cycle assessment of supermarket carrier bags: a review of the bags available in 2006. Bristol; EPA Waste Reduction Model (WARM).

conventional_product.name: Single-Use Plastic Bottled Water (500ml)
conventional_product.material: Virgin Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET) body + HDPE cap

sustainable_product.name: Eco Saathi Bamboo Insulated Flask Bottle (500ml)
sustainable_product.material: Double-walled food grade 304 stainless steel interior wrapped in natural polished bamboo shell

comparisons.lifetime_assumptions: An insulated bamboo-steel bottle replaces approximately 1,000 single-use disposable PET water bottles across 3+ years of daily refills. Embodied flask footprint (2.8 kg CO₂e) amortized over 1,000 refills = 0.0028 kg CO₂e/use.
comparisons.data_source: Quantis & International Bottled Water Association (IBWA) 2018 LCA Study
comparisons.citation: Quantis & IBWA (2018). Life Cycle Assessment of the U.S. Bottled Water Industry; Gleick & Cooley (2009). Energy implications of bottled water. Environmental Research Letters.

sustainable_product.name: Eco Saathi Sabai Grass Dining Table Placemats
sustainable_product.material: Handwoven wild-harvested Sabai grass with azo-free mineral dyes

comparisons.lifetime_assumptions: Independent peer-reviewed life-cycle inventory data for wild-harvested Sabai grass weaving currently in review with Odisha State Agroforestry Board.
comparisons.data_source: Odisha State Handloom & Handicrafts Directorate (Pending certification)
comparisons.citation: Direct LCA certification pending publication. In accordance with Eco Saathi transparency standards, unverified metrics are labeled 'Data not available'.
